details.availability: Public Rust source, npm package and native release binaries; no model weights; models come from the DeepSeek API.

name: Orca
notes: Published by echoVic as the npm package @blade-ai/orca and native binaries for macOS, Linux and Windows; it is primarily a coding agent that reads and edits code and runs commands with a DeepSeek API key. Computer use is one feature: on macOS 14 or later, in the main interactive TUI session, a `computer` tool backed by the bundled crates/orca-computer-use driver lists and launches apps, observes a window as an accessibility-element outline with ids plus an optional screenshot, and clicks, types, sends keys and scrolls on targets (protocol.rs, observation.rs). Per the computer-use docs, each app needs approval unless a rule or full-auto mode allows it, typing into secure password fields always asks separately, password managers and finance apps are blocked by default, Orca never operates its own host terminal, plan mode only lists and observes, and Esc stops the run. Browser tools used from the separate Pilion Browser come from that host. Root LICENSE is MIT; the latest GitHub release is v0.5.12.
summary: DeepSeek-native terminal coding agent in Rust whose bundled macOS computer-use driver lets it observe other apps' accessibility trees and screenshots and click, type, send keys and scroll after per-app approval.
